name: survos/mobile-bundle
description: Declarative #[MobilePage] app pages + generic Framework7/Dexie app-shell wiring for Symfony mobile PWAs

suggest.spomky-labs/pwa-bundle: For installable/offline PWA support (manifest, service worker) — not required, most mobile-bundle apps don't need it.
suggest.ext-imagick: Only if spomky-labs/pwa-bundle's favicon/icon generation is enabled — it needs a real image processor with SVG rasterization support. ext-gd is NOT sufficient (no SVG support). This really belongs as a suggestion on spomky-labs/pwa-bundle itself, not here — noted locally until that lands upstream. Heroku/Dokku's default php buildpack does not install it; add it to your app's own composer.json require to get the buildpack to install it.
